custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'ear' region. AI often confuses seals (no external ears) and sea lions (external ears). If the ear is just a bump or hole, it's likely a seal or a bad generation. Also, scrutinize the skin texture; real sea lions have visible coarse fur even when wet, whereas AI often renders them as smooth otters or seals.
